message:
Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul && cat > /tmp/list_sources.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
ROOT=/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul
# Core assimp sources (exclude C4D, M3D, USD, VRML which are disabled)
find code -name "*.cpp" | grep -v -E "C4D|M3D|Usd|USD|VRML|Wrl|Vrml" 
# contrib sources
echo contrib/pugixml/src/pugixml.cpp
echo contrib/openddlparser/code/OpenDDLCommon.cpp
echo contrib/openddlparser/code/OpenDDLParser.cpp
echo contrib/openddlparser/code/OpenDDLStream.cpp
echo contrib/poly2tri/poly2tri/common/shapes.cpp
echo contrib/poly2tri/poly2tri/sweep/advancing_front.cpp
echo contrib/poly2tri/poly2tri/sweep/cdt.cpp
echo contrib/poly2tri/poly2tri/sweep/sweep_context.cpp
echo contrib/poly2tri/poly2tri/sweep/sweep.cpp
echo contrib/clipper/clipper.cpp
echo contrib/unzip/unzip.c
# zlib
find contrib/zlib -name "*.c"
EOF
bash /tmp/list_sources.sh | wc -l
echo "---sample---"
bash /tmp/list_sources.sh | head -5
